line: Spot inflows support Bitcoin as enforcement actions and regulatory classification reshape the crypto landscape across jurisdictions.
small_line: Written from Bitcoin +1.48% on the day, spot ETF net +5.1M USD (Oct 15, 2026), Fear & Greed 63 (greed), funding +0.0047% per 8h (calm)

wire_top3.line: Brooklyn DA and FBI dismantled Russian-language crypto scam network, seizing 112 servers and shutting 241 domains after victims lost tens of millions.
EU banking authority classified Circle's USDC as 'significant' e-money token under MiCA, activating Nov. 12 supervisory rules.
Solana confirmed Oct. 21 Alpenglow upgrade, replacing TowerBFT voting to cut finality from 12.8 seconds to 150 milliseconds.
